svg.title: FLOP architecture
svg.text: Failproof steers the agent while it works. Lean decides whether the result is a proof.
starts as a stub · agent writes
allowlist only: no logs, reports, answers
warm policy worker · 10 s per policy · logs every decision
run by the agent or the Stop policy
fresh sandbox per run, 3 runs per task
A task counts only if all 3 runs pass.
Answer key eval/answers.txt never enters a sandbox.
